violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by (prep tables). A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026

Pastries packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels in reach-in cooler located in dining area. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Proper labeling guidance provided at time of inspection. Poster for labeling English Food Labels Poster Website for labeling English Food Labeling for Packaged Food New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026

Per interview with PIC the dumpster will be installed next week. PIC will send inspector picture of dumpster once it's been delivered. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 02/12/2026
